breaking_news.headline: Unpacking President Trump's financial stake in Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Dan Alexander, a senior editor at Forbes and author of a book about President Trump's businesses, about the president's holdings in Nvidia given recent news.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia's board under fire for handling of CEO's alleged affairs
breaking_news.summary: Even as Jensen Huang has returned to work, Nvidia's board is facing criticism over how it handled the crisis brought on by the CEO's alleged affairs.

breaking_news.headline: In a time of rising costs, one Thanksgiving commodity is cheaper: cannabis
breaking_news.summary: Steep discounts for "Green Wednesday," one of the highest-selling days for cannabis, help customers keep costs down. But experts say retailers are feeling the pinch.

breaking_news.headline: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
breaking_news.summary: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.

breaking_news.headline: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
breaking_news.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

breaking_news.headline: Credit card perks are fueling airline profitability
breaking_news.summary: Flying during the holidays can be pricey. So, airlines are pitching more and more specialty brand credit cards on your flight.

breaking_news.headline: How Jensen Huang's return as NVIDIA's CEO is going over in China
breaking_news.summary: In China, Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO is being met with a mixed reaction – as Beijing weighs whether it wants the US company's chips at all.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

breaking_news.headline: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
breaking_news.summary: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

breaking_news.headline: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
breaking_news.summary: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
breaking_news.summary: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

breaking_news.headline: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
breaking_news.summary: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

breaking_news.headline: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
breaking_news.summary: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.

breaking_news.headline: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
breaking_news.summary: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.

breaking_news.headline: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.

breaking_news.headline: New boss appointed to lead Travelodge
breaking_news.summary: The new CEO will lead the Thame-based company from 1 December following Jo Boydell's resignation.

breaking_news.headline: Why is there a shortage of 'wizard' elevator mechanics?
breaking_news.summary: The pay is good and there's lots of work, so what's behind the shortage of elevator mechanics?

breaking_news.headline: Simon Jack: Is Poundland's US owner to blame for its collapse?
breaking_news.summary: Poundland's management and MPs blame the retailer's owners, Gordon Brothers, but the US firm says without them the chain would have collapsed last year.

breaking_news.headline: Millions of people to see average monthly mortgage payments rise by £100
breaking_news.summary: More people face higher mortgage repayments when they roll off a fixed deal than previously estimated.
